source_discrepancy: The BFI page headline says £6.48m for 17 Audience Projects Fund projects, while the 17 amounts printed on that same page sum to £6,048,439. SIDONIE preserves both and flags the £431,561 mismatch instead of reconciling it silently.
source_separation: Every recipient row in this pass is National Lottery. BFI Exchequer Grant-in-Aid remains a separate upstream flow.
official_machine_readable_register: BFI publishes official OOXML award files, including April 2024–March 2025 and April 2022-to-date. The binary export was discoverable but not ingestible in this environment, so no rows from it were fabricated.
